rationale: minimum viable, interpretable, low-compute baseline; do not run RF or historical repository model zoo in this step

preprocessing.imputation: none; fail if any non-finite value is encountered
preprocessing.scaler: StandardScaler fit on current training groups only, using file-balanced training-window weights

sample_weighting.file_balanced: each training file has equal total weight = 1/n_windows_in_file; normalize mean training-window weight to 1
sample_weighting.file_and_class_balanced: file-balanced weight multiplied by inverse number of training files in that class; normalize mean to 1

selection_rule: within each outer fold, select among the 6 LR configurations by mean inner-validation file-level Macro-F1 across the frozen 3 inner folds; tie-break by minimum class recall averaged over inner folds, then lower C, then file_balanced before file_and_class_balanced
outer_refit: refit selected configuration on all outer-train-pool groups; evaluate frozen outer-test groups exactly once
score_semantics: use LogisticRegression predict_proba normalized outputs as model score vectors for the frozen mean-across-windows aggregation; they are not calibrated and must not be described as calibrated probabilities/confidence

calibration.reason: no probability/confidence claim in 06-A; all output columns and prose use model score terminology

smoke_test.source_boundary: outer_fold=0, inner_fold=0 only; no outer-test use
